Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aditya - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Kavita - 34 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Savitri - 63 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
4. Vihaan - 8 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Aditya: "What lovely weather!"

[Aditya takes the bag from Mother.]

Aditya: "Mom, look at this."

[A cool breeze blows through the courtyard.]

Kavita: "Hey, look at that!"

[Thick fog covers the village.]

Aditya: "Let's see."

[The sun rises over the village.]

Aditya: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
